approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

params._settlementFeeRecipient: Address of contract that will receive the fees

decimals().details: Returns the number of decimals used to get its user representation. For example, if `decimals` equals `2`, a balance of `505` tokens should be displayed to a user as `5,05` (`505 / 10 ** 2`). Tokens usually opt for a value of 18, imitating the relationship between Ether and Wei. This is the value {ERC20} uses, unless {_setupDecimals} is called. NOTE: This information is only used for _display_ purposes: it in no way affects any of the arithmetic of the contract, including {IERC20-balanceOf} and {IERC20-transfer}.

decreaseAllowance(address,uint256).details: Atomically decreases the allowance granted to `spender` by the caller. This is an alternative to {approve} that can be used as a mitigation for problems described in {IERC20-approve}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address. - `spender` must have allowance for the caller of at least `subtractedValue`.

params.id: Id of the Hedge Contract that is being closed

increaseAllowance(address,uint256).details: Atomically increases the allowance granted to `spender` by the caller. This is an alternative to {approve} that can be used as a mitigation for problems described in {IERC20-approve}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

params.amountToLock: Amount of funds that should be locked in an option
params.id: Id of the Hedge Contract that is being opened
params.totalFee: premium paid for the protection. It will be locked until funds are unlocked

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

params.keep3r: address of the function to receive accumulated rewards

params.amount: Amount to send to the contract
params.minMint: minimum amount of writeUSDC tokens to be minted

returns.mint: amount of writeUSDC minted to provider

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.value: bool option. true if the transfer should be reverted, false if it shouldnt

params._payKeep3r: amount to be saved for the keep3r unwrapping the asset
params.id: Id of the Hedge Contract that is being closed

params.approved: set to true for approval, set to false for rejecting previously granted access

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `recipient` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `amount`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. This is not required by the EIP. See the note at the beginning of {ERC20}. Requirements: - `sender` and `recipient` cannot be the zero address. - `sender` must have a balance of at least `amount`. - the caller must have allowance for ``sender``'s tokens of at least `amount`.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params.id: Id of the Hedge Contract that is being opened

params.amount: Amount to withdraw from the pool
params.maxBurn: maximum amount of writeUSDC to be burned in exchange

returns.burn: amount of writeUSDC burnt from provider

availableBalance().notice: Returns the amount of USDC available for withdrawals

deleteLockedLiquidity(uint256).notice: deletes locked liquidity, receiving a gas refund. used to reduce gas usage

lock(uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: called by WHAsset contract to lock funds and premium (when opening a position)

payKeep3r(address).notice: Function that can only be called by WHAsset contracts to retrieve funds owed to a keep3r

provide(uint256,uint256).notice: A provider supplies USDC to the pool and receives writeUSDC tokens

revertTransfersInLockUpPeriod(bool).notice: Lets each user to decide whether or not they want to allow incoming transfers of locked funds

send(uint256,address,uint256,uint256).notice: function that pays profit (if any) to the hedge contract holder and unlocks premium and liquidity

setAllowedWHAsset(address,bool).notice: Allows new smart contract to open positions using USDC pools

setHegicFeeRecipient(address).notice: Used for changing the Hegic fee recipient

setLockupPeriod(uint256).notice: Used for changing the lockup period

totalBalance().notice: Returns the USDC total balance provided to the pool

unlock(uint256).notice: calls by WHAsset contract to unlock funds and premium (when closing a position, either exercising or unlocking funds)

withdraw(uint256,uint256).notice: A provider supplies writeUSDC to the pool and receives USDC tokens

withdrawHegicFee().notice: Used for withdrawing the Hegic fee

userdoc.notice: Accumulates liquidity in USDC from LPs and distributes P&L in USDC
